The light is the weight is the silence. 
The copper hair is the iron core is the event horizon. 
The screen door slams, but the sound is red-shifted into eternity.

The horizon closes. The Schwarzschild radius is defined. 

The light is gone, yet to the universe outside, it remains frozen at the boundary forever—a permanent, red-shifted monument to an afternoon that never was.
